query: Add the paper with DOI <a DOI already in the library> to the collection for this round.
expected_behavior: Calls zotero:zotero_add_item with if_exists set to file
Reports that the item already exists and only adds the collection
The top-level item count is the same before and after

query: Add this paper: <a DOI with no abstract in OpenAlex or the publisher page>.
expected_behavior: Lists it as skipped with the reason: no abstract available

query: Run a review round on <a topic with no relevant literature in the library or OpenAlex>.
expected_behavior: Agrees on a plan with sub-questions and waits for go
Logs each search with query, source and hit count
Says plainly that nothing relevant was found and adds no padding papers
